question.text: In context with the industrial preparation of hydrogen from water gas $\left(\mathrm{CO}+\mathrm{H}_2\right)$, which of the following is the correct statement?

options.text: $\mathrm{CO}$ and $\mathrm{H}_2$ are fractionally separated using differences in their densities
$\mathrm{CO}$ is removed by absorption in aqueous $\mathrm{Cu}_2 \mathrm{Cl}_2$ solution
$\mathrm{CO}$ is oxidised to $\mathrm{CO}_2$ with steam in the presence of a catalyst followed by absorption of $\mathrm{CO}_2$ in alkali
